findings.text: 面向反复返回同一代码项目的开发者，提供任务续接、带来源的索引召回与经验记录；合格续接仍须回原文件核对。
任务工具、统一安全根、分层召回与 pre-step 注入组成宿主接线；global层不因任务绑定而隔离。
固定根组件中抽读入口、查询、TaskBridge、注入、保存和经验写入；未完整审计所有解析器、UI编辑及第三方依赖，未运行目标代码。
源码package为0.6.9、main=src/index.js，含DSH bundle和Web客户端声明；未验证在线包与该提交对应。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 本地索引存储，金额未知 | 配置、备份、选择项目，耗时未知 | 无模型索引不代表零总成本 |
| 持续使用 | 注入上下文及可选扩展调用 | 回源与经验复核 | 无合格续接成本对照 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试与存储副本 | 查锁、读回、恢复笔记 | 待写可能静默，时间未知 |
| 退出 | 保留已存记录的空间 | 关闭自动注入并回人工笔记 | global文件须单独核对 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 先在单项目备份中按需查询，检查根和任务归属，再新进程读回；来源冲突或回读不符时停止自动注入，返回原文件与人工笔记。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 跨会话定位 | 任务和多层召回已接线 | 正确续接率与节时 |
| 检索可追溯 | 输出路径与行号 | 经验当前正确性 |
| 写入恢复 | 锁失败保留dirty并重试 | 崩溃前持久完成及实际恢复时间 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 统一根策略和分层召回减少不同入口归属漂移；[Q03](#research-q03) 保留脏状态重试有利于恢复，但调用者须区分变更接受与持久化完成。
[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 支持把任务、相关文件与经验召回组合进跨会话开发流程；可减少重新整理的潜在步骤，尚无端到端收益数据。
[Q03](#research-q03) 显示 exact 是状态占位，Saved 只反映变更被接受；锁失败后的待持久化与经验是否仍正确须另行核对。
[Q04](#research-q04) 提出未验证方向，将接受、待持久化、读回确认及来源变化分别展示；用锁竞争和源文件改动对照误信与恢复时间，若总负担不降则放弃。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 兼容 DSH 工具与事件服务 | 核心必需 | 注册工具、任务同步和注入 | 相应入口不能生效；范围见 package 声明 |
| 可写项目存储及备份 | 持久化必需 | 保存分片和任务 | 写入可能待重试，不能依赖成功文字 |
| PDF 解析包 | PDF文档必需 | 提取PDF文本 | 对应文档无法索引 |
| leanvec、LLM扩展 | 可选 | 经验重排、查询扩展 | 向量退回词法；扩展费用未知 |
| skills及Web客户端服务 | 对应入口必需 | 按需指南与任务面板 | 后台工具与这些界面应分开判断 |

      "content": "# dsh-project-memory\n\n> If this plugin saves you an hour of debugging, a star would be appreciated.\n\n[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n[![ci](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/%40yolk_vat-y%2Fdsh-project-memory?style=flat-square&color=orange)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/00080000/dsh-project-memory) [![Awesome](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)\n\n\nA persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Underneath sits a **hybrid index**: document chunks, code symbols, experience notes and insights each form a layer, scored per layer and merged into one ranking. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. Data survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification.\n\n> The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project.\n\n![Task panel: task list, step progress, and involved files](docs/images/image.png)\n\n## Features\n\n- **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-scoping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `select_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. Doc→symbol links are not stored; they are computed at read time.\n- **Verifiability** — **recalls** carry a `path:line` citation where applicable, so the agent can confirm details against the source.\n\nWith default lazy indexing, building the **memory** does not require an upfront scan: files are memorized as the model reads them, so the **memory** grows to cover what has been worked with; `index_repo` or a watched root can cover the rest. Re-reading an unchanged file is a no-op, so the **memory** stays fresh with minimal ongoing overhead.\n\nProject- and task-scope memory is stored per project and follows the codebase: changed files are re-extracted by content hash, deleted files are removed. Experience notes are ordinary `kind: 'experience'` entries in `insights.json`: recallable, deduplicated, and eligible for the same gated hint channel as lessons.\n\n## Design\n\n```\n.dsh-project-memory/\n  format.json      layout marker (v2, sharded)\n  shards/          one self-describing JSON per indexed source file — writes touch only dirty shards\n  watch.json       watched roots\n  tasks.json       TaskBridge task entities (cross-session)\n  binding.json     current session ↔ task binding\n  insights.json    project-scope memory (lessons / decisions / procedures / experience notes) — one entity\n  vectors.json     optional semantic index (only when the vector layer runs)\n  injection-audit.jsonl   one line per real injection (what / why / dropped / budget)\n  admission-shadow.jsonl  one line per step, all scored candidates + features (offline replay)\n```\n\nGlobal-scope entries are not stored under the project: they live in `insight.globalFile` (default `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`) so every project sees them.\n\n- **Incremental** — a content hash per file; only changed files are re-extracted.\n- **Cross-linking** — a returned document chunk resolves the symbols it mentions against the **current** symbol table and appends them as `references`, so a doc indexed before its symbols still links correctly.\n- **Query expansion** — when enabled, `query_memory` asks the LLM to rewrite the query into several variants (synonyms, EN/CN, identifier guesses) and merges the scores; when off, queries never touch the LLM. Indexing itself is model-free.\n- **Consistency** — the fact layer follows the codebase (hash re-extract / remove-on-delete); experience entries are updated through the same supersede and `forget` paths as other insights. Lazily indexed project roots are automatically registered with the watcher, so changed files stay fresh without an explicit `watch_repo`.\n\n**Root resolution.** In order: an explicit `root` argument; a registered root (`watch_repo`); the nearest ancestor with a VCS marker (`.git`/`.hg`/`.svn`) or a build/manifest marker (`package.json`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, …); the session working directory, unless it is on the excluded list. A file that matches none of these is not indexed.\n\nWhen the root comes from the working directory, the model gets one notice per session naming it and how to change it; mute with `autoContext.rootNotice: false`. Starting dsh in a container directory such as `~/workspace` therefore makes that directory the root, and memory spans everything beneath it up to the scan limit — start dsh inside the project for one store per project.\n\n**Excluded directories.** By default, these are not used as a root, matched exactly (subdirectories are unaffected): the filesystem root, the home directory, temp directories — `os.tmpdir()` and the shared ones (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, `%TEMP%`, `%SystemRoot%\\Temp`) — and system / package-manager prefixes (`/opt/homebrew` on POSIX; `%SystemRoot%`, `%ProgramFiles%`, `%ProgramData%` on Windows). A session in one of these runs without memory, with one line on stderr.\n\n**Custom root lists.** The `roots` block overrides that decision. All three accept `~` / `~/...`; non-absolute entries are ignored with a one-time stderr warning (relative paths would resolve against the host cwd and are unpredictable); Windows is case-insensitive:\n\n- `roots.allow` — allow a directory even when it is on the built-in list, matched exactly. The filesystem root is not eligible.\n- `roots.deny` — this directory cannot be a root, matched exactly; its subdirectories can still be roots of their own.\n- `roots.exclude` — no file in this subtree enters the index, matched by path-boundary prefix (subdirectories included); no new root is inferred inside it either. A complete scan of a parent root skips it and removes entries already indexed under it.\n\n`deny` only decides whether the directory itself can be a root: when a parent is already a root, files under a denied child are still indexed by that parent — use `exclude` (or `.gitignore`, which the git-aware scan already honours) to drop the files too. Explicit `index_doc` also respects `exclude` and returns `Not indexed` for a file under it.\n\nPriority is `exclude` > `deny` > `allow` > built-in list. `allowUnsafeRoots: true` only releases the built-in list; `deny` / `exclude` still win. The same verdict is shared by explicit tool calls, lazy indexing, watch, the session audit trail and TaskBridge. Roots refused by the current policy are dropped from `watch.json` on startup. Configure under `config:` of `- id: project-memory`.\n\n**Scan limits.** One pass covers at most `maxScanFiles` files (20000) and `maxScanDepth` directory levels (12). A truncated pass is reported in the `index_repo` result and logged once per root by the watcher, and it does not remove entries it did not reach. A directory that cannot be read (e.g. `EACCES`) counts as a truncated pass too and is named in the result: a read failure is not a deletion.\n\n**Per-file memory budget.** `maxFileSizeMb` is a memory gate, not a disk-space preference. Indexing a file first materializes it — the whole buffer plus decoded text for code, or every PDF page's text plus the joined markdown for documents — and the peak scales with the file's size. Measured on this machine with `npm run bench:peak` (peak RSS fitted against disk size over a 1–50 MB ladder, one fresh process per point): **≈10×** for typical source code (1 declaration per ~1.4 KB), **≈22×** for symbol-dense code (1 per 220 B) and **≈20×** for a text-heavy PDF, on top of a ~52 MB process baseline plus a one-off ≈175 MB the first time a PDF is parsed.       "content": "// 把\"怎么用 project-memory\"作为宿主 skill 暴露，而不是文档里的一段说明。\n//\n// 为什么不写 `.dsh/skills/`：那会把文件写进用户项目或全局 home，且与插件版本脱钩\n// （升级插件后 skill 还是旧的）。运行时注册随包升级，`resourceBase` 指向包内目录，\n// 模型能按相对路径取 `scripts/pm-digest.mjs`。\n//\n// 宿主没有 `skills` 服务时静默跳过 —— 与 `/tasks` 同一套软依赖写法（顶层 inject 会让整个\n// 半边在缺服务时**不挂载**，那是最坏的失败形态，见 src/client/services.ts 的同类注释）。\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport path from 'node:path'\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'\n\nexport const SKILL_NAME = 'project-memory'\n/** 包内目录：`skills/project-memory/`（npm files 白名单里有 `skills`）。 */\nexport const SKILL_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL('../skills/project-memory/', import.meta.url))\n\nconst FRONTMATTER = /^---\\r?\\n([\\s\\S]*?)\\r?\\n---\\r?\\n/\n\n/**\n * 拆 frontmatter 与正文。SKILL.md 是**唯一事实源**（name / description / 正文 / 资源目录），\n * 注册时只解析它，避免\"文件里一份、代码里一份\"的漂移。\n * @param {string} text\n * @returns {{ meta: Record<string,string>, body: string }}\n */\nexport function parseSkillFile(text) {\n  // 记事本/部分编辑器保存 UTF-8 时会带 BOM：`^---` 会因此匹配不上，frontmatter 整段被忽略，\n  // skill 的 name/description 静默回落默认值。BOM 不是内容，先剥掉。\n  const source = String(text || '').replace(/^\\uFEFF/, '')\n  const match = FRONTMATTER.exec(source)\n  const meta = {}\n  if (match) {\n    for (const line of match[1].split(/\\r?\\n/)) {\n      const at = line.indexOf(':')\n      if (at <= 0) continue\n      const key = line.slice(0, at).trim()\n      let value = line.slice(at + 1).trim()\n      if ((value.startsWith('\"') && value.endsWith('\"')) || (value.startsWith(\"'\") && value.endsWith(\"'\"))) {\n        value = value.slice(1, -1)\n      }\n      if (key) meta[key] = value\n    }\n  }\n  return { meta, body: match ? source.slice(match[0].length) : source }\n}\n\n/**\n * 构造 `ctx.skills.register()` 接受的运行时 skill。\n * @param {{ readFile?: (file: string, enc: string) => string, dir?: string }} [opts]\n * @returns {{ name: string, description: string, whenToUse?: string, source: string, path: string, content: string, resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: string } }}\n */\nexport function buildProjectMemorySkill({ readFile = readFileSync, dir = SKILL_DIR } = {}) {\n  const file = path.join(dir, 'SKILL.md')\n  const { meta, body } = parseSkillFile(readFile(file, 'utf8'))\n  const skill = {\n    name: meta.name || SKILL_NAME,\n    description: meta.description || 'Recall and maintain this project\\'s long-term memory: indexed docs and code symbols, lessons, decisions, procedures, and cross-session tasks.',\n    source: 'bundled',\n    path: file,\n    content: body.trim(),\n    resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: dir },\n  }\n  if (meta.whenToUse) skill.whenToUse = meta.whenToUse\n  return skill\n}\n\n/**\n * 把 skill 注册进宿主。`ctx.inject(['skills'], …)` 是可选依赖：没有该服务时回调不执行，\n * 插件其余部分照常工作；注册失败只告警，不影响工具与注入。\n * @param {object} ctx\n * @param {{ build?: () => object, log?: { error: Function } }} [opts]\n */\nexport function setupSkill(ctx, { build = buildProjectMemorySkill, log = console } = {}) {\n  const register = (skillsCtx) => {\n    try {\n      skillsCtx.skills.register(build())\n    } catch (err) {\n      log.error(`[dsh-project-memory] skill registration skipped: ${err?.message || err}`)\n    }\n  }\n  try {\n    if (typeof ctx.inject === 'function') ctx.inject(['skills'], register)\n    else if (typeof ctx.get === 'function' && ctx.get('skills')) register(ctx)\n  } catch (err) {\n    log.error(`[dsh-project-memory] skill registration skipped: ${err?.message || err}`)\n  }\n}\n"
    }
